summary: I read all 29 React components under src/ (5 pages and 24 shared or feature components). Each of the 5 sitemap screens has its page component as its root. The Catalog, Product, Cart and Checkout pages render the same Header and Footer, and the Order page renders neither. Checkout switches between a shipping step and a payment step, keeping the current step in local state. Product reviews are nested: ReviewThread and ReviewItem render each other. The cart store is a plain module that many components read, and saved cards come from AccountContext.

gaps: src/ has no app shell or router. How routes map to pages, and how sku and orderId reach ProductPage and OrderPage, is not visible.
AccountContext (src/stores/account.js) is said to be provided by the app shell, but no Provider exists in src/, so the parent of SavedCardPicker's data is not known.
CheckoutPage receives the card details but never calls src/api/payments.js; no component in src/ uses the payments client.
CheckoutSteps renders either ShippingStep or PaymentStep depending on its step state, so only one shows at a time.
ReviewThread and ReviewItem render each other recursively, so the uses graph has a cycle.
